parameters.content:
## AI morning brief
Every weekday at 7am this reads the last day of your Gmail and today's Google Calendar, has Claude write a one-page brief, and emails it to you.

**Set up (about 30 minutes):**
1. Connect Google in **Recent emails** and **Email me the brief** (Gmail) and **Today's calendar** (Calendar).
2. Paste your Claude API key into the **Claude** node.
3. Put your email address and first name in **Your settings**.
4. Pick the days and hour in **Every weekday morning**, and set your timezone in the workflow settings.
5. Run it once with **Execute workflow**, check your inbox, then switch it to active.

**Using OpenRouter instead?** Delete the **Claude** node, add an **OpenRouter Chat Model**, connect it to **Write the brief**, paste your OpenRouter key, pick a model (e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5) and set Maximum Number of Tokens to 4000.

Made by Swarm · 5warm.ai

parameters.text:
=Write a one-page morning brief for {{ $json.name }}. Today is {{ $json.date }}.

Use only the emails and meetings below. Don't invent facts, times or promises.

Write three sections, in this order, each starting with "## ":
## Urgent
Anything that needs action today. If nothing does, write "Nothing urgent today."
## Today's meetings
One line per meeting: time, title, who's coming, and one thing to prepare.
## Emails to reply to
Only emails a person wrote and expects an answer to. Skip newsletters, receipts, alerts and marketing.
For each: who it's from and what they want, in one line. Then "Draft reply:" and a short reply {{ $json.name }} could send as it is.

Use "- " for list items. Plain English, no filler. Keep the whole brief under 400 words.

MEETINGS
{{ $json.events_text }}

EMAILS ({{ $json.email_count }})
{{ $json.emails_text }}
